acf.speaker_position: Senior Manager, Cloud Engineering at Pegasystems

blocks.html: With 7 years of experience as an IT team manager, I have successfully led diverse teams across various IT domains, prioritising both team efficiency and individual growth. Throughout my career, I have cultivated a deep passion for optimising processes, fostering effective stakeholder collaboration, and ensuring the well-being of my teams, all of which have directly contributed to the delivery of high-quality products. My current mission is to empower and amplify leadership potential in others.
